content.value: Keystones exchange ordinary rules for stronger specialisation. Read both the benefit and the drawback before spending a point. A keystone can make a previously valuable resource or recovery source stop helping.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_void_inoculation|Void Inoculation]] sets maximum Health to 1 and prevents Void damage. It takes precedence over other maximum-Health bonuses. Build around Energy [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] and remember which remaining damage can bypass it.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_crimson_pact|Crimson Pact]] turns Energy [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] into additional maximum Health at twice its value, but disables [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] absorption and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] recovery. It is incompatible with Void Inoculation; that keystone takes precedence.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_iron_reflexes|Iron Reflexes]] converts Evasion Rating into Armour and prevents evading. It can support a reliable physical-mitigation plan, but gives up the chance to avoid a connected hit entirely.
[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_zealots_oath|Zealot's Oath]] sends Health regeneration to Energy [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] instead of Health.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_ghost_reaver|Ghost Reaver]] sends life leech to Energy [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] and disables ordinary [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Shield]] recharge.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_vaal_pact|Vaal Pact]] makes life leech immediate within its replenishing budget, disables Health regeneration and halves on-kill recovery. Keep a recovery answer for periods when you cannot deal damage.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_resolute_technique|Resolute Technique]] prevents eligible attacks from being evaded but prevents your critical strikes. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_elemental_overload|Elemental Overload]] rewards recent critical hits with its elemental effect while removing extra critical-hit damage. Do not invest in Critical Multiplier for hits that cannot use it.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_avatar_of_fire|Avatar of Fire]] converts part of outgoing Physical, Cold and Lightning damage to Fire and removes remaining non-Fire output. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:keystone_point_blank|Point Blank]] rewards close projectile hits and penalises distant ones. Your damage type and fighting distance must match the chosen keystone.
